label: Early copy-phase steps, strongest for very short (L=3-4) and longest (L=9) sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never on original or delimiter steps, and only on inputs that are repeats (copy-phase feedback tokens). Activation peaks at recall_idx 1-2: the top examples are all L=3 sequences at the two copy steps after <DEL>, and L=3 copy steps are ~100% active. Rate is high for L=3-4 and elevated for L=9 early copy steps, low for L=5-8. Some token modulation (input r/p/k, output p/n/f have higher rates), but not enough to define it. The predicate captures ~71% of activation mass at ~37% precision on dev. Many early copy steps of L=9 sequences do not fire, and scattered weak activations at later copy positions for mid-length sequences are missed.
